facts.statement: DemoCo held 1,000 ETH as of 2026-06-30 per the subledger position extract.
DemoCo held 100,000 LCK tokens as of 2026-06-30, acquired under a token purchase agreement dated 2025-12-01.
ETH last-trade prices at 2026-06-30 were 2,501.00 USD (demo-exchange-a) and 2,499.00 USD (demo-exchange-b); the workpaper uses the 2,500.00 USD midpoint.
The pricing vendor's indicative secondary quote for unrestricted LCK tokens was 2.00 USD per token as of 2026-06-30, based on two observed transactions in thin volume.
DemoCo's LCK tokens may not be transferred before 2027-06-30 and are then released monthly over twelve months, per the token purchase agreement.
